title: Call 2: The 20-Minute Prototype & Close
notes: Call 2 prototype reveal and Starbucks Cashier price close. Sentence-level lines with Alex Hormozi vocal cues.

lines.label: Good to see you again
lines.raw: Hey [Name], good to see you again [⬇️]. I've got your custom workflow map and the live prototypes pulled up here [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Recap main goals
lines.raw: [🐢] Before I share my screen, just to recap from our audit: your main goals were freeing yourself from [Admin Pain], making sure no high-value inquiries slip through the cracks while you're [on site / in viewings], and getting consistent marketing and Google reviews running on autopilot [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Still main focus check
lines.raw: Still the main focus, right [🤔]?

lines.label: Pillar 1: Screen while busy
lines.raw: [🐢] First, remember how you mentioned that when calls come in while you're busy, it's tough to screen them immediately? [⏸️]

lines.label: Pillar 1: Live AI setter built
lines.raw: [⚡] Instead of explaining how our AI voice and chat setter works, I built a live one trained on [Company Name] [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Pillar 1: Live phone test
lines.raw: [🐢] Take out your mobile phone right now, put it on speaker, and dial this number [⬇️]. Pretend you're a new client calling in [⬇️].

lines.label: Pillar 1: Pretty wild & never lose 150k
lines.raw: [🐢] Pretty wild, right? [⏸️] That means you never get interrupted on site by a tire-kicker again, and you never lose a 150,000 DKK job to a competitor who picked up the phone faster [⬇️].

lines.label: Pillar 2: Photos into AI video
lines.raw: [⚡] Second, look at my screen here [⬇️]. I took three static photos from your website and ran them through our custom AI video engine [⬇️].

lines.label: Pillar 2: Video & review loop
lines.raw: [🐢] We turn your raw photos into realistic videos like this, run the ad campaigns to bring in high-intent local inquiries, and once you finish the job, our AI automatically follows up with the client politely to get a 5-star Google review [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Pillar 2: Social proof compounds
lines.raw: Your social proof compounds every month without you filming a thing [⬇️].

lines.label: Pillar 3: Backend automation
lines.raw: [🐢] And third, for the [X] hours a week you're losing on [their specific admin pain], we connect a custom AI workflow directly into your backend so that runs automatically in the background [⬇️].

lines.label: Solve bottlenecks check
lines.raw: [🤔] So looking at that whole setup... do you feel like implementing that would solve the bottlenecks we talked about?

lines.label: Most excited piece
lines.raw: [🤔] And out of those three pieces, which one are you most excited to have off your plate first?

lines.label: The one catch upfront
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW - HONEST ADVISOR TONE] Now, let me tell you the one catch upfront, because nothing is magic [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: 30 mins review first 2 weeks
lines.raw: While we build and manage 95% of this for you, during the first two weeks I'm going to need about 30 minutes of your time to review the AI's responses so we dial it in to 100% [⬇️].

lines.label: Can you commit 30 mins
lines.raw: After those two weeks, it runs on rails [⬇️]. [⏸️] Can you commit 30 minutes over the first two weeks to get this right [🤔]?

lines.label: How partnership works
lines.raw: [🐢] Awesome. Let's cover how the partnership works [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Traditional agency cost
lines.raw: Normally, if you hired a traditional agency to run ads, a developer to build custom AI workflows, and a receptionist to answer phones, it easily runs 35,000 to 50,000 DKK ($5,000 to $7,000) a month, plus a big setup fee [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: We do things differently
lines.raw: [⚡] Because we use our own custom AI models internally and eliminated 60% of manual agency work, we do things very differently [⬇️].

lines.label: Zero setup fee
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW - MATTER-OF-FACT CASHIER TONE] Under our Scale Accelerate plan, there is zero setup fee [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Flat $1500 a month
lines.raw: And it's just a flat $1,500 a month (~10,500 DKK) for the entire infrastructure—the 24/7 AI voice and chat, the video ads, the review automation, plus any custom AI builds your firm needs [⬇️]. [⏸️]

lines.label: Onboarding started today
lines.raw: [🐢] Should we get your onboarding started today [⬇️]?

lines.label: Close & setup workspace
lines.raw: Awesome [⬇️]. Let's get your workspace set up right now—takes about two minutes [⬇️].
